scope: RAM/SSD natural-language extraction, Review form hand-off, recommendation selection and result export
changes: RAM parsing now prioritizes 1-4 x N GB module totals, explicit label connectors, and value-before-label wording.
Storage parsing supports SSD/NVMe/storage/hard-drive labels, GB/TB, and natural-language connectors such as is/should be/at least.
Chinese 内存 and 固态硬盘 labels are supported.
VRAM-only mentions do not populate system RAM.
Explicit message values are the source of truth in baseline and both OPT modes; raw model predictions remain saved separately.
Review form values are used to rebuild min-capacity filters and cannot be overridden by stale extraction preferences.
Completed analysis records include raw output, model-only prediction, rule-verified values, reviewed RAM/SSD, and resulting build; JSON and CSV downloads added.

tests.existing_smoke_test: passed (10 original + 9 additional parser/review + 4 build cases)

limitations: Actual pretrained/fine-tuned Hugging Face inference was not executed in this environment because transformers/peft and Streamlit are not installed and base checkpoint download was not performed.
Streamlit UI runtime was syntax-checked but not launched in this environment.
Session history is downloadable but not persistent between Streamlit Cloud sessions; the user must download it.
